name: @w6w-apps/jira
description: Create, search and transition Jira issues, and manage comments, users and projects.

w6w.longDescription:
Jira creates, searches and moves issues through their workflow from outside Jira itself — creating and updating issues, assigning them, and transitioning them between statuses after first reading which transitions are actually available from an issue's current state, rather than guessing at a status name that may not apply.

Comments are a full create/list/delete surface, and issues can be searched with JQL to find exactly the set a workflow needs to act on rather than paging through everything in a project. Projects and users round it out — both can be listed or looked up individually, and users can be searched by name, which matters for resolving who to assign an issue to.

A fit for filing issues from an external event — a bug report, a support escalation, a form submission — and for moving work through a Jira workflow driven by something happening outside Jira.
